svg.title: Space station, technical elevation: 10-bay truss spine with three habitat rings, four solar wings, one array part-deployed, a gantry straddling open bay 5 with a truss section on the hook, radiators, docking collars and antennae.
svg.desc: Seed 1 of the parametric station layer: 10 truss bays of 113 units, 3 habitat rings of 181 units, four solar wings on a 18-unit panel pitch with one array part-deployed, a gantry over open bay 5, lit from the upper left.
